summary: Payment webhook retries exhaust after 3 attempts
description: Outbound webhooks to the payments provider stop retrying after 3 attempts, well short of the documented 8. Root cause looks like the backoff policy resetting the attempt counter when the circuit breaker half-opens. Affects roughly 0.4% of settlements during provider degradation.

summary: EKS node group scaling lags behind burst traffic
description: Cluster autoscaler takes upwards of four minutes to add capacity during the 09:00 traffic burst, causing elevated p99 latency. Evaluate over-provisioning with a low-priority placeholder deployment.

summary: Rotate expiring TLS certificates for internal gateways
description: Four internal gateway certificates expire in August. Move issuance to cert-manager with automated renewal rather than the current manual process.

summary: Alert fatigue: 60% of pages are non-actionable
description: Review the last quarter of pages and retire or re-threshold every alert that did not lead to an action. Target a 50% reduction in overnight pages.

summary: Postgres connection pool exhaustion during nightly batch
description: The reconciliation batch opens connections without bounding concurrency, starving the API tier between 02:00 and 02:40.

summary: Introduce an MCP gateway in front of third-party MCP servers
description: AI assistants need governed access to internal systems. Stand up a gateway that curates which MCP tools are exposed, enforces per-tool authorisation and rate limits, and keeps upstream credentials away from clients.

summary: Token exchange for per-user upstream identity
description: The gateway currently authenticates upstream with a service credential, so the upstream cannot distinguish callers. Investigate OAuth token exchange so the source system's own permission model still applies per user.

summary: Rate limit noisy internal API consumers
description: Apply subscription-tier throttling to internal consumers. Two batch jobs currently account for 70% of gateway traffic.

summary: Publish an OpenAPI style guide and lint in CI
description: Codify naming, pagination and error-shape conventions as a Spectral ruleset, enforced on every pull request touching an API definition.

summary: Idempotency keys for all mutating platform endpoints
description: Client retries currently risk duplicate side effects. Require an Idempotency-Key header on every POST and PUT, with a 24-hour replay window.

summary: Deprecate v1 identity endpoints
description: Three consumers remain on the v1 identity API. Agree a sunset date and publish a migration guide.

summary: Structured audit log for gateway policy decisions
description: Every allow and deny decision at the gateway should emit a structured record naming the principal, the resource and the rule that fired. Current analytics report the transport path only, which is too coarse to audit tool-level access.

summary: Checkout form loses state on browser back navigation
description: Navigating back from the payment step clears every field above it. Introduced by the move to the new form library in release 2026.7.

summary: Colour contrast failures on the dark theme
description: Fourteen components fail WCAG AA contrast in dark mode, mostly secondary text on elevated surfaces. Fix at the token level rather than per component.

summary: Reduce first-contentful-paint on the landing page
description: Landing page FCP was 3.1s on a throttled 4G profile. Target under 1.8s through font subsetting, critical CSS inlining and deferring the analytics bundle.

summary: Design tokens package drifts from the mobile client
description: The Android client pins a design-tokens version four releases behind, so spacing and colour diverge from the web application.

summary: Session expiry gives no warning before data loss
description: Long-running forms are discarded silently when the session expires. Warn at two minutes remaining and offer a silent refresh.

summary: Search results ignore the selected locale
description: The search endpoint receives the browser Accept-Language header rather than the locale chosen in the profile.

summary: Terraform state locking fails on concurrent applies
description: Two pipelines applying to the staging workspace simultaneously corrupt the DynamoDB lock entry, leaving state locked until manually released.

summary: Catalogue of approved AI tool integrations
description: Developers need one place to discover which AI tool integrations are approved, what each can access, and how to request access. Evaluate using the existing developer portal rather than building something new.
